items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions, leading to account takeover and privilege escalation. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild at the time of the update.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, which could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: CosmicSting Attack: Persistent Backdoors and Mass Abuse
items.summary: A critical attack method, dubbed 'CosmicSting,' was observed to be actively exploited, threatening a large percentage of Adobe Commerce stores by injecting malicious scripts and persistent backdoors.

items.title: Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Magento Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in JTL Shop
items.summary: A critical template injection flaw in JTL Shop, an e-commerce platform, allows anonymous attackers to steal database credentials and execute arbitrary code.

items.title: OptinMonster Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: A supply chain attack affecting sites using OptinMonster, TrustPulse, or PushEngage plugins, leading to the addition of admin accounts and hidden backdoors.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image, bypassing validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
